SHORT ANSWERTranslate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.

Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.

They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first

FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.

  • 01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?

A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.

I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.

You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.

  • 02

How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?

Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.

Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.

For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.

fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height

FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?

Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.

I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.

Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.

  • 04

How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?

A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.

This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.

You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.

Worked example

  • STAR answer

Before

I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.

After

When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.

How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself

The takeaways

  • 01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
  • 02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
  • 03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
  • 04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.

Questions people ask

Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?

Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.

Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?

No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.

How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?

Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

title: Influencer Marketing Lead
description:
At Aftershoot, we're building a global community of photographers who spend less time behind their screens and more time behind the lens. Every feature we create, every update we ship, is designed to make post-processing easier, faster, and smarter for photographers around the world.

From culling to editing to retouching. Our AI tools do all the heavy lifting, so photographers can focus on what they do best: capturing moments, telling stories, and creating magic.

We're a fast-growing, passionate team backed by 100K+ active users globally. Double-digit ARR in less than 4 years, amazing investors and a team who truly believe in our mission.

Our mission is clear: Become the default companion for every photographer in the world. If you care deeply about building meaningful products, working with curious and driven teammates, and being part of a team that genuinely loves what they do, we'd love to meet you.

Let's create the future of AI in photography, together.

About the Role

This is a function-owner role, not an execution role.

Aftershoot already invests seven figures a year into creators, and creator-led content is one of the biggest drivers of how photographers discover us. What we don't yet have is someone who owns it end to end: who decides where the money goes, which creators earn a renewal, what the content should actually say, and how we prove any of it worked.

That's you. You'll set the strategy, own the budget, build the partner roster, and lead a small team of executives who handle day-to-day outreach and campaign management. Most of our creators are based in the US, so you'll be working across US time zones on a regular basis.

You'll come in with a clear mandate: make the same spend go three times further, or deliver the same results for meaningfully less. Both are good answers.

What You'll Do

â¢ Own Aftershoot's global influencer and creator marketing strategy end to end, with the US as the primary market.

â¢ Own the annual creator budget: allocate it, defend it, sunset what isn't working, and double down on what is.

â¢ Build and maintain the partner roster across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, spanning photography, creative-tools, and tech audiences.â¢ Move the program from one-off sponsored posts toward recurring partnerships, ambassador structures, and long-term creator relationships.

â¢ Build the measurement layer: attribution, incrementality, cost per trial and per paid conversion by creator, so renewal decisions are made on evidence rather than instinct.

â¢ Negotiate rates, deliverables, exclusivity, and usage rights, including whitelisting so strong creator content can be repurposed into paid media.

â¢ Get content actually shipped: briefing creators, holding them to timelines, and getting the work over the line when it slips.

â¢ Hire, manage, and coach a team of 2â3 Influencer Marketing Executives.

â¢ Work closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, and Design so creator content plugs into the wider marketing engine rather than running beside it.

â¢ Plan and run creator activity around peak moments like Black Friday and major product launches.

â¢ Explore adjacent channels where they make sense: affiliate, community, events, and podcast partnerships.

What You'll Bring

â¢ 5â8 years in influencer, creator, or partnerships marketing, at an agency or in-house, with at least 2 of those years setting strategy rather than only executing campaigns.

â¢ Direct experience managing a meaningful creator budget, and the ability to walk us through how you spent it and what you got back.

â¢ Experience working with US or international creators, and comfort operating across time zones.

â¢ Excellent spoken and written English. Much of this job is video calls and negotiation with US-based creators, so you need to be clear, natural, and persuasive live.

â¢ Real negotiation instincts. Paying a creator is the beginning of the relationship, not the end of it, and getting good work out of a partner takes persistence and charm in equal measure.

â¢ Comfort with numbers: you can look at a campaign and form a point of view on whether it earned its keep.

â¢ Working knowledge of creator tooling and affiliate platforms (GRIN, CreatorIQ, Modash, Upfluence, Aspire, Impact.com, PartnerStack, or similar).

â¢ A bias toward action. We move fast, we test in the market rather than in slide decks, and we'd rather fix a live campaign than perfect a plan.

Nice to have, genuinely not required

â¢ A background in photography, creative tools, or prosumer software.

â¢ Experience in a consumer AI or global SaaS company.

â¢ Experience building a creator program from zero.

We are not filtering for photography experience. If you've built creator programs in D2C, gaming, fintech, or anywhere else that scales, the playbook travels.

What You'll Gain

â¢ Full ownership of a function from day one, with a seven-figure budget and no legacy playbook to inherit.

â¢ Direct line to leadership and real influence over how Aftershoot grows.

â¢ A global creator community in a category people are genuinely passionate about.

â¢ The chance to build a team around you as the program scales.

What Happens After You Apply?

  1. Phone Screen â If your profile looks like a fit, our People team will reach out for an intro call.

  2. Team Interview â A deeper conversation on your experience and how you've run creator programs before.

  3. Case Discussion â We'll share real context on our program a day ahead, then talk through how you'd approach it. No 20-slide deck required.

  4. Bar-Raiser Interview â Meet our leadership team for a final evaluation.

  5. Offer! â If it goes well, we'll extend a formal offer and welcome you on board.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

title: Billing Officer
description:
Job Description â Billing Officer

Job Title: Billing Officer

Department: Finance & Accounts

Reporting To: Finance Manager / Accounts Manager

Experience: 2â4 years in billing, invoicing, or accounts-related roles

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Billing Officer will be responsible for managing the company's billing and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of invoices, proper documentation, reconciliation of billing records, and coordination with internal departments and customers. The role requires strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and good knowledge of accounting and billing procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, bills, credit notes, debit notes, and related billing documents.
  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.
  • Assist in preparing billing-related MIS and periodic reports for management.
  • Handle customer queries related to invoices, billing adjustments, credit notes, and payment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, company policies, and internal control procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of financial and customer information.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to billing and receivables.
  • Identify billing errors or process gaps and recommend improvements where required.
  • Perform other finance and accounting duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or a related field.
  • 2â4 years of relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable.
  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and billing procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple invoices and deadlines efficiently.
  • Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ERP/accounting software such as Tally, SAP, Odoo, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of VAT, TDS, and other applicable tax-related billing requirements.
  • Experience in handling high-volume billing operations.
  • Good understanding of sales, inventory, and accounts receivable processes.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Numerical & Analytical Ability
  • Time Management
  • Problem-Solving
  • Communication & Coordination
  • Accountability
  • Integrity & Confidentiality
  • Process Orientation
  • Teamwork

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of invoice generation
  • Billing error and discrepancy rate
  • Timely reconciliation of billing records
  • Resolution time for billing-related issues
  • Accuracy of billing MIS and documentation
  • Compliance with internal billing and financial procedures

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

title: Maintenance Planner
description:

We are seeking a Maintenance Planner to join our Engineering Stores team. In this role, you will be responsible for effectively planning, preparing, and scheduling maintenance activities to support equipment reliability, maximize plant availability, and reduce unplanned downtime.   • Manages maintenance task lists and ensures required materials are requested in line with inventory and supply processes.
  • Ensures accurate and timely registration and management of maintenance information within the CMMS.
  • Supports preventive maintenance planning and contributes to the preparation of maintenance budgets.
  • Supports TPM and continuous improvement activities to improve maintenance effectiveness, reliability, and plant availability.
  • Works closely with maintenance stakeholders to improve planning efficiency, reduce downtime, and support reliable execution of maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.

Knowledge & Experience:

  • 2â5 years of experience in maintenance planning, operations, supply chain, or a reliability-focused role.
  • Experience in maintenance planning, preparation, and scheduling.
  • Good understanding of supply and inventory management processes.
  • Experience working with a CMMS and/or maintenance planning and scheduling software.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to plan ahead and manage multiple priorities.
  • Good reporting, data handling, and basic computer skills.
  • Understanding of workflow management and maintenance work prioritization.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Supply Chain.

title: Account Executive (DACH)
description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.

Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.

Why Strong Sellers Join Singu

  • A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.

  • Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.

  • Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.

  • Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.

What You Will Own

Pipeline and Coverage

  • A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.

  • Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.

  • Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.

Deal Execution

  • Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.

  • Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.

  • Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.

  • Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

Commercial outcomes

  • New-logo ARR against quota

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.

  • By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.

  • The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.

  • A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.

  • CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.

Package, Support and Progression

  • Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.

  • Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

Compensation: €5K – €5.8K per month • Offers Commission

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
description:
Deine Mission

Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird.
Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse.

Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München-Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut.
Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein.

Was du wirklich machst

  • AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen.
  • Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden.
  • AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung.
  • Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben.
  • Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact.
Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt

Hier lernst du nicht programmieren - du lernst, wie man AI-Investitionen bewertet, Business Cases baut, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership bestehen, und komplexe Themen so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht. Genau das Handwerk, das du später in der Strategieberatung oder im Corporate Strategy-Umfeld brauchst - nur, dass die Empfehlung hier real umgesetzt wird und nicht in einer Präsentation endet.
Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Business Judgement und AI.
Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat.


Dein Skillset

  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit - idealerweise mit strategischem oder analytischem Fokus.
  • AI-affin, kein AI Engineer: Du musst nicht coden können und keine Modelle bauen. Aber du nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT als Power-User für Recherche, Analyse und Strukturierung - und verstehst, wie AI Geschäftsprozesse verändert. Wichtiger als technisches Tiefenwissen: Du erkennst, welches Problem ein AI-Use-Case eigentlich lösen soll.
  • Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten.
  • Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor.
  • Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16–20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität, bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich.


Dein Winning Deal

  • Deine Chance: Vom ersten Tag an arbeitest du an einer der strategisch wichtigsten AI-Initiativen unseres Unternehmens mit und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag tausender Menschen verbessern können.
  • Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert.
  • Dein Netzwerk: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers, Product-, Strategy- und Operations-Expert:innen - Einblicke, die klassische Werkstudentenstellen selten bieten.
  • Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. 
  • Deine Benefits:Neben weekly Pizza und Snacks vor Ort, bieten wir dir außerdem einen Joblunch-Zuschuss (4 x 6,90 € im Monat), eine bezuschusste Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits" sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz: Flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell in einem unserer modernen, hundefreundlichen Büros.
  • Dein Beitrag: Eine Position in einem profitablen Unternehmen, in dem du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen hast, mitzugestalten und mit uns an der „Future of Work" zu arbeiten.
  • Unsere Werte: Eine offene, authentische Kultur und ein leistungsstarkes, humorvolles Team, das sich darauf freut, gemeinsam mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen.

description:
Build the product engine behind the next generation of MedTech software.

REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

Now we’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead / Head of Product to help us turn ambitious product direction into exceptional shipped product.

The role

This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.

Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.

You will own how we get there.

You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:

Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning.

You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers, raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.

You won’t be managing the process from the sidelines. You’ll be in the details with customers, PMs, engineers and designers, making decisions and helping the team ship.

What you’ll do

  • Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

  • Lead and develop the Product team: Manage 2–3 PMs, help them sharpen their judgment and execution, and establish a consistently high bar for product work.

  • Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

  • Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

  • Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

  • Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

  • Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

  • Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

What we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product.

  • Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers.

  • Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

  • Have owned product delivery across multiple squads or product areas.

  • Have strong product judgment and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

  • Are genuinely AI-forward: you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

We’ll be especially excited if you

  • Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

  • Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs.

  • Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

  • Have experienced both sides of the journey: building product in an early-stage environment and later helping a product organization scale.

Why REMATIQ?

  • A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product systems and ways of working for our next stage are still yours to shape.

  • Real product ownership: You’ll have genuine authority over prioritization, product definition and execution, while staying close enough to the work to personally influence what gets built.

  • Player-coach by design: This isn’t a role where leadership means leaving product craft behind. You’ll build the team while continuing to own meaningful product problems yourself.

  • AI is the product and the way we work: You’ll help define what an AI-native product organization should actually look like, rather than simply adding AI tools to traditional processes.

  • Complex problems worth solving: Our customers operate in environments where workflows are technical, regulated and mission-critical. The product challenges are correspondingly deep.

  • Work directly with the people shaping the company: Partner closely with the founders, Engineering and Design on the decisions that determine what REMATIQ becomes.

  • Meaningful impact: Better software can help medical innovators reduce manual work, navigate complexity and bring important products to market faster and more safely.

  • Compensation and ownership: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a meaningful stake in the company you’re helping to build.

title: Head of Finance and Operations
description:
Join REMATIQ in revolutionizing medical innovation.

Join us on our mission to help medical innovators bring life-saving products to market faster and safer.

About REMATIQ

REMATIQ builds AI software for life sciences and medical device companies. Our platform helps teams automate complex documentation and compliance workflows, while keeping outputs traceable, reviewable, and audit-ready.

Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. REMATIQ helps customers simplify this work, reduce manual effort, and move faster without compromising on quality or compliance.

We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, having recently closed a Series A round.

What you’ll do

With high customer demand and fresh investment, our teams are growing quickly. As Head of Finance & Operations, you’ll build the operating backbone for REMATIQ’s next stage of growth. Following our Series A, you’ll work directly with the founders to shape how we plan, allocate resources, hire, operate and scale the company. Finance, HR, Contracting, and Company Operations will initially sit within your function. You’ll build the people, processes, and systems needed to run them well, with individual areas growing into dedicated functions as the company scales.

Concretely, the following falls in the scope of the role:

  • Own financial planning and reporting: Deeply understand both historical and future financial performance and key KPI, proactively report to changes and report to investors and the company.

  • Ensure proper accounting: Closely work with our external accounting firm and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate closing of our books.

  • Oversee HR and People operations: Own the smooth running of core people processes, from payroll and employee administration to performance reviews, recruiting coordination and onboarding, until these areas grow into a dedicated People function.

  • Structure recruiting and onboarding: Work with external and internal recruiters to ensure a great candidate experience and the right quality bar of our talent.

  • Legal, compliance and contracting: Work with our external legal counsel and our suppliers to enforce policies and negotiate offers.

  • Company operations: Coordinate our OKR setting process, office logistics, legal setup, open new entities and everything else which ensures smooth sailing.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who combines strong financial judgment with the breadth and pragmatism of an early-stage operator. You’ve built before, know which processes need rigor and which need to stay lightweight, and use AI and automation thoughtfully to turn ambiguity into systems that work.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Operations and finance experience: You’ve built the ops and finance function in Series A companies from scratch before, know where to go deep and where to be pragmatic.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills: You are strong at conceptual framing, analysis, synthesis, and turning complex information into clear recommendations.

  • AI-native working style: You actively use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work, improve decision-making and build internal processes differently from a traditional finance or operations function.

  • Executive communication: Building a clear story with data is second nature to you.

  • Startup mindset: You are adaptable, resilient, hands-on, positive under pressure, and willing to take on challenges beyond a narrow job description.

  • Unquestionable ethics and diligence: We will trust you with all our financial and HR data.

  • Fluency in English, German preferred.

Why join REMATIQ?

  • Rare timing: With strong customer demand and our Series A recently closed, we're entering the stage where the systems that worked for an early team need to become the foundations of a scalable company.

  • Real ownership: Finance, People Operations, contracting and company operations start with you. You won't inherit a mature function; you'll decide what to build, automate, outsource and eventually turn into dedicated teams.

  • Founder access and influence: Work directly with the founders on financial planning, hiring, organisational priorities and the decisions that determine how REMATIQ scales.

  • Purposeful work: Be part of a mission-driven team transforming how medical devices reach the market — in an industry where quality, compliance, and patient safety mean nothing can be left to chance.

  • Compensation & growth: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a stake in the success you help create.

What You Bring

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

title: Senior GL Accountant (Fixed Term Contract)

description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Go-To-Market at LILT

Go-to-market at LILT is our strategic growth engine. Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Revenue Operations run together. We're responsible for telling LILT's story and what makes us different from other translation options in the market. We tell that story to the world with effective demand generation programs, and we turn it into revenue through the outbound and inbound motions our reps run every day. We're shaping how people understand LILT's brand, product, and the category we're building.

We're expert storytellers and operators who work across the entire funnel, from awareness to conversion to expansion. We partner closely with Product and Customer Success to drive pipeline, accelerate adoption, and position LILT as the market leader in enterprise AI translation.

This role has a cross-functional mandate by design. The systems that matter most right now sit on the Sales and RevOps side as much as the Marketing side: Account routing, the lead-to-opportunity process, ADR-facing tooling, signal scanning for the reps. You'll have explicit standing to audit, redesign, and rebuild AI workflows across all of our growth systems.

We're building a world-class team and we're looking for ambitious, curious people who want to grow fast, work with seasoned operators, and help shape the future of AI and language.

Whether it's crafting compelling narratives, launching new capabilities, running high-impact campaigns, or engineering the systems underneath all of it, we move fast, think big, and care deeply about quality. If you're excited about AI, language, and building a category-defining company, you'll thrive here. It's a place to work if you want to have a real impact, learn a ton, working hands-on building content, campaigns, programs, and systems you can be proud of.

GTM Engineering at LILT

As LILT scales, more of our go-to-market motion is powered by agentic AI, systems that can research, enrich, sequence, and act on our behalf, not just report on what already happened. This role sits at the center of that shift. You'll be the builder who turns "we should automate this" into a working, reliable system, owning the tools and automations that keep Marketing, Sales, and RevOps running smoothly.

Examples of the kinds of systems that live in this role:

  • AI-driven meeting and lead qualification agents that compile evidence from across our stack to make a judgment

  • Account signal-scoring systems that combine data into a ranked, defensible view of where the team should spend its time

  • AI-drafted outbound at scale, personalized from live account context

These are illustrative rather than a fixed backlog. The specific builds will change; the shape of the work won't.

Where You'll Work

This role is based in our London office. We work in a hybrid model, with team members in the office 3 days per week to collaborate, brainstorm, and build together. You'll get the energy and creativity of in-person work, combined with the flexibility to focus from home when needed.

What You'll Do

This high-impact, hands-on role is responsible for owning LILT's agentic GTM systems: proposing, designing, building, and maintaining the AI-driven tools and automations that power our go-to-market engine, including our Clay-based enrichment and outbound workflows. You'll also play a critical role in optimizing our go-to-market technology stack, streamlining our lead-to-opportunity process, and helping to maintain day-to-day department operations.

You'll work closely with GTM leadership across Sales Development, Sales, Marketing, and Operations and Systems functions to drive process optimization and overall efficiency. You'll recommend, build, and run cross-functional projects and process improvements that directly impact our operational efficiency and top-line growth of all revenue lines. You'll contribute to the strategy and execution of full-funnel programs that drive predictable, scalable pipeline.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agentic business systems integration. Propose, design, build, and maintain agentic AI tools and automations that connect and orchestrate our GTM stack end-to-end, reducing manual work and increasing the speed and reliability of our lead-to-revenue motion.

  • Own Clay and the automation stack. Serve as our resident expert on Clay (and similar enrichment/orchestration tools), building and maintaining tables, waterfalls, and workflows that keep our data accurate and our outbound motion running.

  • Salesforce lead-to-opportunity. Partner closely with RevOps to own the workflow from a new lead entering the system, through the various lead stages, and converting to an opportunity, including routing, assignment, and the rules that decide who works what.

  • Full-funnel ownership. Design and optimize the entire lead funnel, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL to SQL handoff, driving higher conversion and increased velocity.

  • Lead and contact data integrity. Work with internal tools and external vendors to maintain a high quality database of contacts across our target industries and personas.

  • Partner with Sales. Align tightly with revenue leadership to define pipeline goals, campaign targeting, SLAs, and lead management workflows. Sit close enough to the reps to know which parts of the process actually hurt.

  • Fuel growth. Partner closely with the demand gen team to drive multi-channel campaigns across email marketing, webinars, paid media, SEO, events, outbound motions, and ABM to meet ambitious growth targets.

  • Use data to scale. Build a data-driven culture. Forecast, measure, and communicate program results, continuously optimizing for ROI and CAC efficiency.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally. Work across demand gen, product marketing, ADRs, and sales ops to build cohesive, conversion-optimized systems and campaigns.

  • Department operations. Help with department-level planning for things like managing campaign budget, team meetings and activities, and annual planning.

  • Documentation and knowledge continuity. Maintain living documentation (Notion) for every agent and workflow you own, to a standard where a new team member or another AI agent could pick up ownership without a live handover call. This is a stated expectation of the role, not an afterthought.

Our Stack

  • CRM and RevOps: Salesforce, Default

  • Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo

  • Outbound and conversation intelligence: Amplemarket, Trellus

  • Inbound and web conversion: Qualified

  • Marketing automation: HubSpot

  • Analytics: GA4, Salesforce reporting, Looker Studio

  • Build environment: Python, LLM APIs, agentic coding tools, Notion for documentation

Skills and Experience

  • 3-5 years in B2B SaaS or AI/ML go-to-market engineering, RevOps, or marketing operations, with a track record of building automations that actually ship.

  • Hands-on Clay expertise. You've built waterfall enrichment, scoring, and routing in Clay (or a comparable tool), and you can take a new use case from idea to live quickly.

  • Agentic AI and automation fluency. Comfortable proposing, designing, and building agentic workflows and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and orchestration tools, to connect systems and eliminate manual work.

  • Working proficiency in Python/other languages for building and maintaining AI agent pipelines. Comfortable working inside an existing codebase, not just writing standalone scripts.

  • Comfortable reasoning about tradeoffs under cost and token constraints. You can explain not just what you built, but why you didn't build the more expensive or more complex version.

  • Strong Salesforce fundamentals. You can build reports, understand the object model and the automation layer, and use what you find to change how the funnel actually performs.

  • A point of view on where AI in GTM is heading. We'll ask. We're less interested in whether we agree than in whether you've thought about it seriously.

  • Obsessed with the metrics that matter: MQLs, pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, velocity, CAC, and ROI.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot or similar) a plus.

  • Ability to build relationships and work cross-functionally.

  • Smart, curious, and hard-working.

  • Natural collaborator and communicator, comfortable presenting to executives, boards, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

title: Director of Systems Delivery
description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover.

Job Summary

As a Senior Solution Consultant – ITSM, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them translate business and service management challenges into practical, scalable solutions built on Atlassian tools and industry best practices.

You will lead discovery and solution design, guide customers through ITSM transformation, and own the solution intent throughout delivery. description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

As Associate Director, Platform Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the hybrid compute infrastructure, developer platform and scientific compute environments that power Relation’s machine learning and drug discovery work. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work closely with your team and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

Our platform spans on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, supporting computational scientist notebooks through Kubeflow, model training and serving, internal services and genomic pipelines. You will set the technical direction across these areas, build and develop the team responsible for delivering them, and ensure our platform continues to evolve alongside the needs of our science.

Day to day, you will

  • Partner with the VP of Engineering and peers across Engineering, Data Science and Machine Learning to define and evolve Relation’s platform strategy.

  • Own the architectural strategy for our Kubernetes-based clusters and broader hybrid infrastructure, setting the technical standards and guardrails within which the team designs, builds and operates.

  • Lead and develop the Platform Engineering team, hiring and retaining exceptional engineers, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

  • Drive the maturity of our CI/CD pipelines, internal services and developer tooling, treating the platform as a product and our internal engineers and computational scientists as its customers.

  • Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Significant experience in platform, infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with a strong track record of building and operating complex production environments.

  • Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. You have set technical direction others have followed, mentored and developed engineers, and taken accountability for live production systems.

  • Strong hands-on operational experience. You have participated in on-call rotations for production infrastructure, led responses to significant incidents and driven the subsequent changes required to prevent recurrence.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments.

  • Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving.

  • Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines.

  • A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms.

  • Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Experience:

  • Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment.

 

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!
