title: Head EMEA Refund Fraud, Integrity - Fixed Term Contract
description:
About the Role

The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace.

You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers.

This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment.

You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy

    • Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap.

    • Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.

    • Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest.

    • Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls.

    • Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments.

  2. Owning Performance and Risk

    • Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails.

    • Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost.

    • Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions.

    • Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken.

    • Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats.

  3. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities

    • Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys.

    • Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place.

    • Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions.

    • Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails.

    • Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention.

    • Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value.

  4. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment

    • Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams.

    • Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line.

    • Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension.

    • Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus.

    • Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact.

    • Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

  5. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

    • Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals.

    • Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members.

    • Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction.

    • Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks.

    • Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs.

    • Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions.

    • Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring:

  • Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years.

  • Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects.

  • A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon.

  • Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences.

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance.

  • Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions.

  • Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions.

  • Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations.

Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it.

What Success Looks Like

  • In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities.

  • You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities.

  • You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets. We combine deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure to unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets.

As we scale, we are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and manage the infrastructure that connects our marketing activity with sales. This is a hands-on role focused on making HubSpot a powerful operating system for understanding contact engagement, identifying intent signals, delivering relevant nurture, and helping our sales team engage the right people at the right time.

This is not an inbound lead-generation or MQL-focused role. The objective is to understand how contacts are engaging with Tangible over time — what they are reading, which campaigns they respond to, what they do on our website, and other relevant signals — so that we can identify increasing levels of interest and act quickly.

You will own the day-to-day marketing operations architecture in HubSpot, while also managing nurture campaigns, marketing messaging and the operational side of content. You will work closely with leadership and Sales to ensure our marketing activity generates useful signals and actionable intelligence, rather than simply producing more leads.

Tasks

HubSpot & Marketing Operations

  • Own and manage Tangible's HubSpot marketing operations architecture.
  • Build, maintain and optimise HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Ensure HubSpot is correctly structured to capture and connect engagement data across marketing channels.
  • Develop robust processes for tracking contact engagement across email, website activity, content consumption, campaigns and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Maintain data quality, contact lifecycle processes and the overall integrity of the marketing database.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the way HubSpot supports Marketing and Sales as the business scales.
  • Ensure marketing activity is properly tracked and connected to the CRM so engagement can be understood at an individual contact level.

Engagement Scoring & Intent Signals

  • Build and continuously refine contact engagement scoring based on meaningful behavioural signals.
  • Develop scoring models that help us understand when an existing contact is becoming more engaged or showing increased intent.
  • Combine signals such as content engagement, website activity, email interactions, campaign participation and other relevant behaviours.
  • Use scoring to help Sales identify who is becoming more engaged and who should be contacted sooner.
  • Continuously test and refine scoring logic based on what actually proves useful to Sales.
  • Clearly communicate engagement signals and changes in contact behaviour to the sales team.
  • Ensure scoring is used as a prioritisation and intelligence tool, rather than simply as an inbound lead/MQL qualification model.

Nurture & Marketing Automation

  • Design, build and manage nurture programmes in HubSpot.
  • Develop segmented nurture journeys based on audience, interests, engagement and stage of relationship.
  • Manage the messaging, sequencing and logic behind automated campaigns.
  • Test subject lines, messaging, timing, segmentation and calls to action to improve engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to move contacts between different nurture journeys based on their behaviour.
  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimise programmes based on engagement and commercial outcomes.

Messaging & Sales Enablement

  • Work closely with Sales to understand the messaging and information they need to engage prospects effectively.
  • Develop and manage marketing messaging for nurture campaigns, email campaigns and other targeted communications.
  • Support Sales with relevant outreach messaging, follow-ups, campaign assets and other enablement materials.
  • Use engagement data and audience behaviour to inform messaging and help Sales personalise outreach.
  • Help Sales understand how to interpret and act on engagement signals coming from HubSpot.
  • Identify content and messaging that can support specific sales conversations and commercial priorities.

Content Operations
Content is not the primary responsibility of this role. Instead, you will ensure that Tangible's content is properly integrated into our marketing operations infrastructure.

  • Ensure content assets, reports, newsletters and other marketing activity are properly connected to HubSpot.
  • Make sure content engagement can be tracked at the contact level and incorporated into relevant segmentation and scoring.
  • Work with the wider team to ensure campaigns and content launches are set up correctly from an operational perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to use existing content within nurture programmes and sales journeys.
  • Report on which content is generating meaningful engagement and signals of interest.

Reporting & Optimisation

  • Build clear reporting around contact engagement, campaign performance, nurture activity and sales signals.
  • Provide leadership and Sales with actionable insight rather than vanity metrics.
  • Identify patterns in contact behaviour and engagement that can inform marketing and sales activity.
  • Measure the effectiveness of nurture programmes, scoring models and marketing campaigns.
  • Continuously improve the marketing operations infrastructure based on data, feedback and commercial outcomes.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and Sales to align marketing operations with commercial priorities.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure engagement signals are genuinely useful in day-to-day prospecting and relationship management.
  • Help establish the processes and infrastructure required as Tangible's marketing and sales activity scales.
  • Act as the internal owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot marketing operations.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years' experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related B2B marketing role.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing HubSpot architecture. This is a must-have.
  • Demonstrable experience building and managing HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Experience designing and managing engagement or behavioural scoring models.
  • A strong understanding of how behavioural signals can be used to prioritise contacts and improve Sales engagement.
  • Experience building and optimising nurture campaigns and automated customer/prospect journeys.
  • Comfortable working across Marketing and Sales and translating commercial requirements into practical marketing-operations solutions.
  • Strong understanding of contact data, segmentation, lifecycle management and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to analyse engagement data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong copywriting and messaging skills, particularly for B2B audiences and nurture campaigns.
  • Commercially minded, with an understanding that marketing operations should ultimately help Sales have better conversations with the right people.
  • Highly organised, analytical and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable owning the function independently and building processes from the ground up.
  • Experience in private markets, PE/VC, financial services or another complex B2B environment is preferred.

What You'll Own

This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You will be responsible for making sure Tangible's marketing infrastructure works properly — from the underlying HubSpot architecture through to scoring, segmentation, nurture and the signals delivered to Sales.

The ideal person is someone who enjoys building systems, understanding how people behave, and turning data into action. You should be equally comfortable getting deep into a HubSpot workflow and working with Sales on how a particular engagement signal should change their approach.

You will have the opportunity to build the marketing operations function as Tangible scales, with significant ownership over the systems, processes and programmes that connect marketing activity to revenue.

description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior System Analyst to join our Platform team. You'll own 2–3 domains across core banking, payments, and transfers, taking them end-to-end: from solution design and partner integrations to production support. 
If you enjoy deep technical challenges in the financial domain and want real ownership over what you build – this is the role for you.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution.
